postings.title: Site Reliability Engineer
postings.description:
Site Reliability Engineer
You will be a part of our MSP teams focusing on Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) services.
Who are we?
In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient! There is an ever-growing need to have rapid security capabilities in place. Organizations are looking towards trusted strategic partners to offer the valuable expertise and know-how in the Security Intelligence space. That's where we come in!
Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we are committed to helping companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions. We serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.
At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.
Your mission: what can you expect from this role?
You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. Your expertise and performance will directly impact the experience of our valued clients. The most relevant technologies for the SRE team are the following ones:
AWS
GitHub
Nutanix Prism
HashiCorp Terraform
HashiCorp Vault
HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
Ansible
Microsoft Entra ID
Microsoft Azure
PingIdentity PingOne for customers
Rocky Linux
Key responsibilities:
Design and implementation: You will be designing and implementing zero-touch production concepts across all levels of our MSP technology stack, leveraging applications Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cribl Stream and Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR automation and orchestration capabilities to enhance operational efficiency. You will also be designing and implementing cloud infrastructure architecture, with a focus on AWS, Nutanix Prism, Microsoft Azure and Rocky Linux. This also includes IAM solutions, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), based on Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
Automation: You'll develop automation capabilities for all value services, through CI/CD pipelines design and development.
Version Control & Release Management: You'll be managing version control effectively using platforms such as GitHub. On the other hand, you'll be utilizing release management tools to streamline software deployment processes.
Secret Management Solutions: Implementing secret management solutions like HashiCorp HCP Vault for MSP backends.
Documentation: Generating and automating documentation using tools like Atlassian Confluence to ensure comprehensive system documentation.
Hello, is it me you're looking for?
You have a strong background in computer science, computer engineering, or IT security (a degree is an asset).
Experience with some of the following technologies: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Rocky Linux, Ansible, HashiCorp product portfolio, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
Experience with one or more of the following is highly recommended: Git, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, Python v3, JavaScript.
Affinity with threat detection platforms like SIEM technologies (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Stack, etc) and/or XDR technologies (Microsoft Defender XDR, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, etc) is an asset.
You communicate in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. French is an asset.
You are a problem solver with an analytical mind. As a team player with a positive attitude, you are always ready to challenge and to be challenged.
What we offer
You come to us for the job, but you stay for the people.
They are the backbone of our organization, and that's reflected in the rewards we offer:
An attractive salary package: An absolute must to bring out the best in you.
The opportunity to make a difference in a challenging, digital world: We offer an environment where you can learn and provide you with the tools to invest in yourself and become the best version of your (professional) self!
A challenging work environment and an inspiring team: In our high-performing and dynamic teams, your initiative is valued, and you're accepted for who you are. Your uniqueness excites us.
A great vibe in a cozy office in Berchem: We love food, drinks, and laughter! We work hard and play even harder. We celebrate teamwork, organize quarterly team events, and during breaks, you can enjoy a game of pool, darts, or table tennis with your colleagues.
Do you want to know why a ‘one team’ mentality is a better driver for success than hierarchy? Are you that missing piece in our Davinsi Labs DNA who shares our core values of focus, excellence and passion? Do you think you have the skill and mindset we are looking for? Come and join us at Davinsi Labs. Fill in the form or email us at career(at)davinsi.com and show us your passion.
For current job openings,

you can always take a look at our open jobs.
